ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, and $C$ is a point on $\odot O$. If $\angle BCO=35^\circ$ and $AO=2$, then what is the length of $\overset{\frown}{AC}$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\angle BCO=35^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle AOC=2\angle BCO=70^\circ$,\\
and given that $AO=2$,\\
thus, the arc $\overset{\frown}{AC}=\frac{n\pi r}{180}=\frac{70\pi \times 2}{180}=\frac{140\pi }{180}=\boxed{\frac{7}{9}\pi}$.
